youtube_full.title: The Words Written Again | Bedtime Scripture Story for Kids | Jeremiah 36:27–32
youtube_full.description:
The Words Written Again: a bedtime scripture story for kids from Jeremiah 36:27–32.

Jeremiah had a friend named Baruch. Jeremiah said Heavenly Father’s words out loud.

Tonight's Scripture Traveler: Beau the Brave.

Read along as the pages turn, then answer the bedtime questions together.

0:00 Opening the book
0:11 The story: The Words Written Again
1:14 Scripture Traveler of the Night: Beau the Brave
1:49 A Feeling Moment and the Five Stones
2:58 Question time
3:16 Sweet dreams
3:34 More stories, the app and the paperback
